name: Joja Junk Mail
summary: JojaMart starts sending you cheerful, slightly ridiculous advertising letters every Wednesday morning.
logoPrompt: A bright blue envelope stuffed with colourful advertising flyers and coupons, a red price tag hanging from its corner
description: **Joja Junk Mail fills your mailbox with JojaMart advertising: one cheerful, slightly ridiculous offer every Wednesday morning.**
- One advertising letter a week, on Wednesday, the day a certain small general store takes a break.
- Sixteen different offers per year, four per season, from canned snow to pumpkin spice cola.
- Written on the JojaMart letter paper, in the company's very sincere tone.
- No items, no money and no changes to the game, just something to read with your morning coffee.
Install SMAPI and Content Patcher, then unzip the file into your `Mods` folder. Check your mailbox on the next Wednesday.
- Needs SMAPI and Content Patcher 2.9.0 or newer. Made for Stardew Valley 1.6.
- Built carefully from the documented formats of Stardew Valley 1.6 and Content Patcher.
- The letters stop once the Community Center is restored or the Joja community development form is completed.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
